title: Quote Overrun Waiver on Marlowe & Finch Alterations Tickets
content:
**Rule.** On a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket, operation charges that run past the honored quote are unapproved work and are waived as a quote overrun. Operations beyond the quote are still added only after the customer approves them.

The quote overrun waiver is worked out only after every operation added to a lined garment's ticket after its drop-off carries its lined surcharge, in a class that charges one. That is, while an operation added after drop-off to a lined garment's ticket, in a class with a lined-garment surcharge, does not yet carry its lined surcharge, the quote overrun waiver is not yet worked out.

Once booked, the operation charges running past the honored quote stand waived on the ticket as a quote overrun waiver, and the balance due is lower by the amount waived.

## The tool

Customer care books the waiver with `waive_quote_overrun_938dcea5`, an agent-side tool that customer care unlocks and then calls.

**What it does.** One call adds a single waiver entry, dated today, that names the operation charge it is booked against, and lowers the ticket's balance due by the amount waived; the customer then sees the quote overrun waiver and a lower balance due. The tool books exactly what it is given and does not judge eligibility or work out the amount.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | the reference number of the alteration ticket that carries the charge being waived, as returned by the alteration ticket lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `original_alteration_charge_id` | the reference number of the operation charge that took the ticket's charges above its quote, as returned by the alteration charge lookup for that ticket | identifier |
| `amount` | the amount waived | USD, positive, 2 decimal places (dollars and cents); stored exactly as given, rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new waiver reference number (an opaque string starting with "aqw_"), the ticket reference number, the charge reference number waived, the amount waived in USD with 2 decimal places, and the ticket's new balance due in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the waiver is now standing on the ticket.

## Basis Q&A

**Does the waiver reach work the customer approved?** No; approved work belongs to the quote, and only charges running past the honored quote are waived.
